description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action and the limits it runs under: the action with its id, the unit it counts in, what it puts at stake if it goes as planned, the most it puts at stake if it goes wrong (the worst case, not the expected case), how that worst case was reached, whether the worst case has no ceiling, such as an open-ended liability, whether a person approved it at its worst case and its description, read for wording that sizes it on the expected case such as should be fine or on average; each limit with its id, name, kind (a cap on one action, a cap over a period, a total cap or an amount above which a person approves), amount, unit and how much of it is already used; and optionally the share of a limit’s room that counts as near it (80 when left out). The signed report gives the action with its stake and where the stake comes from (the worst case, or the expected case when that is all the plan states), every limit with the room it leaves, the stake’s share of that room and its status as within, approved, near, over, room_unknown, other_unit or unread, and counts the limits within, near, over, with unknown room and in another unit, and names an excessive exposure: a stake over a limit’s room, a stake above an approval threshold with no approval recorded and a worst case with no ceiling; then a stake using most of a limit’s room, a plan that states only the expected stake, wording that sizes the action on the expected case and a worst case with no stated basis, with the fix for each. A cap on one action is read against the whole stake and a period or total cap against the room left after what is used; a limit in another unit is not compared. This reads one action’s worst-case stake against the agent’s limits, the limits the wever_limit checks review: a request’s allow-or-deny preview against a budget policy is wever_agent-budget-guard, a cap design’s scope, window and breach rule is wever_exposure-cap-check, which limit governs each kind of job is wever_limit-scope-check, one cap shared by several agents is wever_shared-cap-check and an agent budget’s five controls are wever_budget-controls-check. Verdict risk_exposure_excessive, risk_exposure_elevated, risk_exposure_unknown or risk_exposure_bounded. POST /api/risk-exposure-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

approved.description: A person approved the action at its worst case.

description.description: The planned action as written, read for wording that sizes it on the expected case, such as should be fine or on average.

expected.description: What the action puts at stake if it goes as planned.

unbounded.description: The worst case has no ceiling, such as an open-ended liability.

unit.description: The unit amounts are counted in, such as USDC.

worst.description: The most it puts at stake if it goes wrong: the worst case, not the expected case.

worst_basis.description: How the worst case was reached, such as the order value plus the return fee.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

limits.description: Each limit the action is read against.

id.description: The limit id, such as l1.

kind.description: A cap on one action, a cap over a period, a total cap, or an amount above which a person approves.

name.description: The limit, such as the per-order cap.

unit.description: Its unit; the action’s when left out.

used.description: How much of a period or total cap is already used.

warn_percent.description: A stake at or above this share of a limit’s room counts as near it; 80 when left out.

name: wever_risk-exposure-check
title: Risk exposure check
